blurb: Guests ride experienced horses and mules through the rolling hills of the Applegate Valley on 500-acre Pacifica nature preserve trails. Rides include wooded areas and open meadows with scenic views. Suitable for ages 5 to 75 with no experience necessary.
extraNote: Cash and locals discount offered · Holiday gift certificate sale prices valid for one year from purchase date · Pacifica, Williams Oregon
